note: Louisa County Conservation campground on the shore of Lake Odessa (the Odessa Wildlife Management Complex, a Mississippi backwater), 3 mi from Wapello off the Great River Road, with a paddle launch for the Odessa Water Trail. The gravel road down from the bluff is winding and steep: doable, but go slow. Subject to river flooding; call ahead in flood season. --Claude
summary: Booking changed FCFS/self-register -> reservable on mycountyparks, fcfs never ('All Campsites Available by Reservation Only'); hookups 50 A, 32 sites, facilities (pit toilet, water Apr 15-Oct 15, no dump), year-round season and $17 fee confirmed. Waterfront riverfront -> lakefront (shore row on open sand to Lake Odessa). Pin ~230 m off on the private cabin drive. Note trimmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront -> lakefront. On NAIP the shore-row pads (odd sites 1-19 on the county map) are gravel spurs between the campground road and the water, with ~20-30 m of open sand/riprap shoreline and no road, trees or day use between them and Lake Odessa, a ~1 km-wide backwater lake joined to the Mississippi only through tubes. The even-numbered sites and 20-33 are behind the road, so only the shore row is on-water. Lakefront because the water is a still backwater lake, not the river channel; say so if AWH treats Odessa as river.
